entities.summary: Sizwe Mpofu-Walsh (b. 1989-01-04, Johannesburg) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Johannesburg. Known in the fields of composers & musicians.
